summary: Wrote and verified the host-prerequisite and systemd user-timer guides, extended the docs drift suite to cover both, and documented the Podman window, 6.x exclusion, 4.9 upgrade paths, lingering, git/Node/port minimums, lock behavior, and all exit codes.

payload.agentOutputExcerpt: Wrote and verified the host-prerequisite and systemd user-timer guides, extended the docs drift suite to cover both, and documented the Podman window, 6.x exclusion, 4.9 upgrade paths, lingering, git/Node/port minimums, lock behavior, and all exit codes.
decisions: Ports are documented as having no host-wide doctor check by design; enforcement is the add/update preflight (INVALID_PORT exit 1, PORT_CONFLICT exit 6).
The timer guide presents one unit pair per app so each failure and exit code stays attributable to one app.
The links test derives the Podman range, git/Node/port minimums, lock file mode, and boot service from runtime constants rather than hard-coded prose.
interfaces: DOCUMENTED_MARKDOWN now includes docs/operations/prerequisites.md and docs/operations/systemd-timer.md.
agentReportedTests: npm run lint: exit 0 (3 pre-existing info diagnostics, unrelated files)
warnings: The in-place Podman 4.9.3 upgrade on Ubuntu 24.04 and Debian 12 was not replayed and is reported as unverified in the guide.
Podman 5.8.x is covered by doctor unit tests only; the release gate ran 5.7.0.
podman-docker is verified only on the Ubuntu gate host.
Timer ExecStart and PATH values are templates that operators must resolve with command -v.
validationLimitations: No clean-shell manual walkthrough of the guides was run; it requires network installs and a prepared Podman host.
payload.taskDescription: Write docs/operations/prerequisites.md covering rootless Podman 5.7.0 to 5.8.x with an upgrade path from 4.9 on Ubuntu 24.04 and Debian 12, an explicit note that 6.x is excluded while unstable, lingering with its reboot consequence, git 2.40, Node 24, and ports at or above 1024, each with a verification command and the matching doctor check. Write docs/operations/systemd-timer.md with user unit files that run update for one app, enable commands, log location, and the note that overlapping runs exit on the app lock. Extend the docs link test to cover both files.
